question: Can a trainable public-role and operator encoder injected INSIDE the existing width32 native HybridPilot stem generalize to a new composition of familiar operator primitives, outperform a matched flat stem, the same role encoder as an external additive sidecar, original native, and strongest fully-trained conventional tagged set/MLP/GRU on unfamiliar operator composition and cold world?

source.program_semantics: base=0 is SELECTOR_MUX(A[yes] if A[selector]>0 else A[no]); base=1 is PARITY(product of all four A factors); negate=1 multiplies base result by -1. Train MUX/normal, MUX/negated, PARITY/normal; never train PARITY/negated. This tests novel composition of familiar primitives, NOT a newly invented unfamiliar primitive.
source.binding: TRAIN role triples (0,1,2),(1,2,3),(2,3,0) round-robin; DEV_COMPOSE/OOD_SHIFT/ROLE_REASSIGN bind to (3,0,1), withheld. Combined operator+role binding is held out; cannot isolate which alone limits performance.
source.fresh_physics: R85 pure constructor with new independent panel/seed/index RNG; independently redraw four A factors [-1,+1], replace R85 old index-law by specified public program output; no previous R85-R97 scored generator/source. Same physical probe timing/B factors except OOD shift.
source.public: Original physics 224 ticks, R85 lawful preaction physical rollout and R86 selected 48x13 physical prefix; inject PUBLIC encoded instruction into the 4 observed A-probe event channel8: (tag + 4*base + 8*negate)/15, tag in {0=distractor,1=selector,2=yes,3=no}; row9 original role ID, row10 actual noisy factor cue, row11 original A phase; no outcome/hidden law injected. Every model receives same public instructions and causal factor observations. 5×13 observed A/pivot rows selected only, NOT full 224 recurrent observations.
source.chosen_action: CALIBRATE iff ((world_index//4)+(seed_index))%2==0; otherwise EXPLOIT_POS; exact index design balance across cold/early, heldout law sampled independently of index. Only ONE realized nine-tick return under chosen factual intervention is available to training. Never unchosen branch, hidden law, evaluator labels or precomputed public parity/mux teacher.
source.test_panels: DEV_SEEN uses familiar program and familiar role binding; DEV_COMPOSE is PARITY+NEGATED with heldout binding; shifted OOD repeats unknown combination under 68/208 pivot and increased noise; ROLE_REASSIGN changes only role assignment for an unseen PARITY+NEGATE world, which is role-invariant; must treat role-reassignment flip rate as ZERO true physical-law change control rather than falsely demand an action flip. Also include program-change counterfactual PARITY+NEGATE to MUX+NEGATE on identical physical A factors to test actual changed physical law and action responsiveness.
source.alternative_program_panel: ROLE_REASSIGN evaluator changes PUBLIC base primitive from PARITY to MUX while keeping negate flag 1, role binding (3,0,1), A/B factors, noise, time and chosen-action prefix fixed; recompute physical law; truth changes in subset and allow action-flip measure.
source.negative: Tag/program-blind conventional 14D MLP with four role tags and both program bits zeroed. Shared role+operator encoder with public program bits randomly flipped per world selected by seed-only RNG (not law-selected), preserving physical A probes, chosen action/time and true outcome; audit must disclose residual signal and not claim complete causal-information removal.
source.negative_anticipated_caveat: Even program-bit corruption retains original physical cue information, potentially predicting law under training-family priors; only a program-disruption control, not independent causal-null.
source.law_audits: Precommit per public cold/early and selected action true-law positive rates [.35,.65]; negative program-bit corruption and its induced physical-law alignment reported but NOT used to choose sampled labels, draw new data, or claim negative is independent. No post hoc reruns.

architecture.native: Original R74 HybridPilot_FULL width32, R75 exact triangular TTT replacement. Original stem (13->32), SSM, causal attention, TTT, hard depth and final original head are preserved; no edit to model.py or official source.
architecture.internal_role_program: Within an isolated research wrapper, trainable shared four-event encoder (public noisy factor, onehot public role instruction, two public opcode bits) forms a 32D learned context, which is added to the LAST PIVOT STEM ACTIVATION before original SSM/attention/TTT/depth/head. No additive output readout, all trainable gradients enter original native trunk and native head; this is internally conditioned architecture, not proof original core invents a new operator.
architecture.flat_stem: Same original native with comparable conventional flat 14D MLP producing 32D last-stem feature addition; account for unmatched parameter budgets explicitly.
architecture.external_sidecar: Same role+program context encoder as the internal arm but an independent trainable scalar value readout added AFTER original native core, distinct negative for the internal-injection hypothesis.
architecture.conventional: Fully trained 14D flat MLP64; shared tagged-role set encoder plus public program bits and own scalar value readout; GRU64 on exact same 5x13 original selected rows. All use identical FIT physical action/return minibatches.
architecture.canonical_upper: ENGINEERED observed public tags resolve selector/yes/no roles and signs/parity; 14D canonical observation MLP must still train factual reward. NOT a model discovering operator semantics, only an explicit public-rule-based diagnostic.
architecture.negative: Same role-set architecture/initialized weights as positive role-set, but two public opcode bits corrupted per-world by independent deterministic RNG. Does not supply private law to trainable model.
